title: 3.1.11a Lab — Color and background
description: Create three Cubes at different positions and set a different color on each, with a dark background.

steps.title: Set the background
steps.instructions: Call `background('#111')` in setup() to set the scene to a dark near-black.
hints: background() in setup() sets the initial scene color. Also call it in draw() to clear each frame.

steps.title: Create a crimson Cube on the left
steps.instructions: Create a Cube at (-2, 0, 0) and set its color to 'crimson'.
hints: Negative X is to the left.

steps.title: Create a gold Cube in the center
steps.instructions: Create a Cube at (0, 0, 0) and set its color to 'gold'.
hints: X=0 is the center of the scene.

steps.title: Create a deepskyblue Cube on the right
steps.instructions: Create a Cube at (2, 0, 0) and set its color to 'deepskyblue'.
hints: Positive X is to the right.

requirements.title: At least one Cube created
requirements.description: A Cube is instantiated with new Cube(...).

requirements.title: At least one color set
requirements.description: The .color property is assigned on a shape.

requirements.title: background() is called
requirements.description: background() is called with a color argument.
